examples.title: Example 1: Setting Up a Two-Panel Layout
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to control the region for a two-panel layout on a foldable screen across different states: folded, expanded, and hover.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting Up a Three-Panel Layout
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to control the region for a three-panel layout on a foldable screen across different states: folded, expanded, and hover.

examples.title: Example 3: Configuring the Folded, Hover, and Expanded States of FoldSplitContainer
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use ExpandedRegionLayoutOptions, HoverModeRegionLayoutOptions, and FoldedRegionLayoutOptions to configure the layout information of the expanded, hover, and folded states of the foldable device. MajorRegion, MinorRegion, and ExtraRegion represent the primary, secondary, and extra regions divided by the component. These regions are implemented with the encapsulated Region component. RadioOptions stands for the encapsulated radio switch component, while SwitchOption refers to the encapsulated toggle switch component.
